infino on the hosted infino platform, queried over its REST API.
Built against the published infino 0.11.2 crate: each query is an HTTPS request to /v1/bm25_search or /v1/count (TOP_k_COUNT sends one of each).

Latency is the platform's own query time, from the x-infino-query-time response header (TOP_k_COUNT adds both requests). It excludes the network and the platform's gateway, so it measures the engine as the platform runs it.
Queries are paced to stay under the platform's limit of 20 requests a second.
The platform builds and compacts the table itself; it is not compacted to a single superfile.
Same full-text setup as the local infino engines: standard analyzer, positions on, text not stored, BM25 with k1=1.2 and b=0.75, table-wide statistics.
Supports +must, plain should, -must-not and quoted phrases. *_FF is unsupported.
